name: klipper-ls
description: Hover docs, go-to-definition, diagnostics and highlighting for Klipper printer.cfg, macros and sliced G-code, powered by klipper-ls. Works alongside any Klipper syntax extension.

klipper.server.path.markdownDescription: Path to a `klipper-ls` binary. Leave empty to use `klipper-ls` from your `PATH`, or else download the latest release automatically.

klipper.klipperDocs.markdownDescription: Klipper's `docs` folder, for example `~/klipper/docs`. Leave empty to use a `klipper/docs` folder near your config, or else download the docs once.

klipper.klipperConfig.markdownDescription: Your `printer.cfg`, or the folder that contains it. Used to find your macros when you hover in a `.gcode` file.

klipper.marlinDocs.markdownDescription: A Marlin documentation checkout, or its `_gcode` folder, for per-parameter detail on standard G-codes. Leave empty to download it once.

klipper.diagnostics.markdownDescription: Report what can be known to be wrong without running Klipper: unknown Jinja filters and tests, pin chips nothing in the config provides, `printer.*` objects no section creates, and commands Klipper doesn't register. Turn off to keep only hover and go-to-definition.

klipper.downloadDocs.markdownDescription: Download Klipper's and Marlin's docs when no local copy is found. Turn off to never use the network for docs; hovers then show only your own macros.

klipper.trace.server.markdownDescription: Log the language server's LSP traffic in the **Klipper** output channel. Use `verbose` when reporting a bug.

scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json && node out-test/runTest.js
scripts.package: npm run typecheck && npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies
scripts.screenshots: npm run build && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json && node out-test/screenshots/run.js
